common.action.cancel.note: Dismiss an edit or dialog without saving; short button label.

common.action.save.note: Save the current edit; short button label.

common.action.dismiss.note: Accessible label for the close control on a notification.

common.action.retry.note: Retry a failed screen load or request; friendly button label.

common.action.continue.note: Proceed to the next step; short button label.

common.action.back.note: Return to the previous step; short button label.

common.action.edit.note: Open a value for editing; short button label.

common.action.remove.note: Remove the selected item after confirmation; short button label.

common.action.working.note: Screen-reader label while a button is busy.

common.value.unknown.note: A missing measurement, never zero or an assumed result.

common.time.start.note: Accessible label for the first time input in a time range.

common.time.end.note: Accessible label for the second time input in a time range.

common.time.to.note: Short separator between the start and end of a time range.

common.duration.minutes.note: Duration-format fallback; count is the numeric rounded duration in minutes.

common.points.total.note: Points balance in account rows; count is a numeric points value.

common.points.earned.note: Run row points earned; count is a numeric points value.

common.task.searches.note: Task name for desktop searches; keep short in a ruled task row.

common.task.daily_set.note: Task name for the daily set of Rewards activities.

common.task.misc_cards.note: Task name for miscellaneous activity cards; short row label.

common.task.explore_on_bing.note: Task name for Bing Explore activities; Bing is a product name, not app branding.

common.task.visual_search.note: Task name for the visual-search activity.

common.task_status.ok.note: Task finished successfully and is not measured still open.

common.task_status.skip.note: Task intentionally skipped; a reason may follow.

common.task_status.fail.note: Task failed; a reason may follow.

common.task_status.not_run.note: Task did not execute in this run.

common.task_status.none.note: No recorded check or outcome for this task today; do not imply the task is unavailable or completed.

common.task_status.open.note: Task still measured open, even if a past run was successful.

common.chart.balance.note: Accessible title and data-table column for the balance chart.

common.chart.earned.note: Accessible title and data-table column for daily earned points.

common.chart.date.note: Date column header in the chart's accessible data table.

common.chart.empty.note: Shown when the chart has no measured values; missing data is not zero.

common.goal.remaining.note: Plain goal line; count is the numeric remaining points, not a price.

common.goal.days.note: Goal estimate when history is sufficient; count is numeric estimated days.

common.goal.estimate_unknown.text: More history needed for an estimate
common.goal.estimate_unknown.note: Goal has no defensible estimated date yet.

common.goal.none.note: Invitation when the user has not set a goal.

common.goal.set.note: Open the inline goal editor; short button label.

common.goal.edit.note: Open the existing goal in its inline editor.

common.goal.target.note: Label for the numeric goal target; allowed range is 100 to 1,000,000.

common.goal.choose.note: Label for the shared goal editor's preset selector, without market-specific prices.

common.goal.preset_points.note: Generic goal preset option; count is numeric target points, never a reward price.

common.goal.custom.note: Goal selector option showing the custom numeric field.

common.goal.clear.note: Remove the saved goal, leaving no target or forecast; inline editor button.

common.run.active.note: Run row status while the run is active.

common.log.title.note: Technical log disclosure label and accessible name; log text stays left-to-right.

common.log.load_more.note: Continue reading the run log from its next byte offset; shown until the file's current end.

common.account.paused.note: Account is excluded from scheduled runs.

common.account.signed_out.note: Account status measured signed out; state label, not the sign-in action.

common.account.ready.note: Account has a recorded signed-in state.

common.account.unknown.note: Account sign-in status is unknown, not assumed signed in.

common.section.searches.note: Readable points-breakdown section name, inserted into a list in state errors.

common.section.daily_set.note: Readable points-breakdown section name, inserted into a list in state errors.

common.section.cards.note: Readable points-breakdown section name, inserted into a list in state errors.

common.section.quests.note: Readable points-breakdown section name, inserted into a list in state errors.

common.section.balance.note: Readable points-breakdown section name, inserted into a list in state errors.

common.risk_notice.text: Use at your own risk. Microsoft may take action against your account for using automated scripts to gain Rewards points.
common.risk_notice.note: Visible setup risk notice, exact README wording per CONTRACT 7.1. Do not imply that automation is safe.
